_ghi_chu: MAU cau hinh Zalo gon. Chep thanh cau-hinh.json roi sua theo may cua ban. Sua xong: dong Zalo, mo lai bang loi tat Zalo gon. Phim tat xem bang F1 trong Zalo.

duong_dan._ghi_chu: Duong dan rieng tung may. De trong thi module tuong ung tat (Trello: 70-trello.js, So kho: 85-kho.js).

che_rieng_tu._ghi_chu: Ctrl+Shift+B: lam mo anh dai dien, dong xem truoc, noi dung chat. Re chuot vao dau thi cho do ro.

gio_lam._ghi_chu: Trong gio lam: lam mo cac cuoc tro chuyen 'on ao'. Ctrl+Shift+G: tu dong -> luon bat -> tat.

quang_cao._ghi_chu: An khoi quang cao co chua mot trong cac chuoi nay (vi du o zBusiness Pro dau danh sach).

khach_cho._ghi_chu: Chat 1-1 ma nguoi kia nhan sau cung, qua so gio nay chua tra loi -> cham do + so gio cho.

trello._ghi_chu: Ctrl+Shift+T: tao the tu tin nhan dang re chuot (hoac doan chu dang boi den). Luon chay thu truoc, bam Tao the moi ghi. Can khai duong_dan.trello_mcp (thu muc chua otl_trello.py cua rieng ban).

chan_gui_nham._ghi_chu: Gui vao NHOM ma tin co cac mau nay -> hoi lai, bam Enter lan nua moi gui. Regex khong phan biet hoa thuong.

go_tat._ghi_chu: Go /ma roi Tab (hoac chon trong bang goi y). Ma nao de trong thi chua dung duoc - dien noi dung vao.

xuat._ghi_chu: Ctrl+Shift+S: luu cuoc tro chuyen dang mo ra Markdown + HTML.
